The lion 's mane jellyfish ( Cyanea capillata ) , also known as the giant jellyfish or the hair jelly
is the largest known species of jellyfish
Its range is confined to cold , boreal waters of the Arctic , northern Atlantic , and northern Pacific Oceans
It is common in the English Channel , Irish Sea , North Sea
It is common in the English Channel , Irish Sea , North Sea and in western Scandinavian waters south to Kattegat and Øresund
It may also drift in to the south - western part of the Baltic Sea
It may also drift in to the south - western part of the Baltic Sea ( where it can not breed due to the low salinity )
Similar jellyfish -- which may be the same species -- are known to inhabit seas near Australia and New Zealand
